arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import time, re
p='/tmp/flutter_run.log'
start=time.time()
pat=re.compile(r'http://127\.0\.0\.1:(\d+)/',re.I)
while time.time()-start<120:
    try:
        s=open(p).read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        s=''
    m=pat.search(s)
    if m:
        print('FOUND',m.group(1))
        break
    time.sleep(2)
else:
    print('NOTFOUND')
    print(s[-2000:])
PY
